title: Ostomy Supply Program Written Order, Prior Authorization and Coverage Verification Terms
content:
Each payer tier of the Ostomy Supply Program fixes how long a prescriber's written order lasts, whether the payer requires prior authorization, how long an authorization lasts and how quickly the payer decides, and how recently coverage must have been verified before a refill ships.

## Terms

- **Written order validity** - the validity of the prescriber's written order, in calendar months counted from the order date.
- **Prior authorization required** - whether the payer requires prior authorization before this product line ships.
- **Prior authorization validity** - the validity of a payer prior authorization, in calendar months counted from the payer decision date, unless the payer's approval states an earlier valid-through date; 0 means no prior authorization on the tier.
- **Renewal lead** - the earliest point for submitting a prior authorization renewal, in calendar days before the valid-through date of the authorization being renewed; 0 means no prior authorization on the tier.
- **Standard decision time** - the payer's decision time for a standard prior authorization request, in calendar days counted from the request date; 0 means no prior authorization.
- **Expedited decision time** - the payer's decision time for an expedited prior authorization request, in hours counted from submission; 0 means no prior authorization.
- **Coverage re-verification** - how recently the coverage record must have been verified with the payer before a refill ships, in calendar months counted back from the ship date; 0 means no coverage to verify.

## Terms by tier

| Tier | Order validity | Prior authorization required | Authorization validity | Renewal lead | Standard decision | Expedited decision | Coverage re-verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ostomy Self-Pay Program | 12 months | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 (no coverage) |
| Ostomy Commercial HMO Program | 12 months | Yes | 6 months | 30 days | 15 days | 72 hours | 6 months |
| Ostomy Commercial PPO Program | 12 months | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 months |
| Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program | 12 months | Yes | 12 months | 30 days | 7 days | 72 hours | 12 months |
| Ostomy Original Medicare Program | 12 months | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 months |
| Ostomy Medicaid Program | 12 months | Yes | 6 months | 21 days | 7 days | 72 hours | 1 month |

## Reading the table

- Prior authorization applies on three tiers: the Ostomy Commercial HMO Program, the Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program and the Ostomy Medicaid Program. On the other three every authorization value is 0.
- A written order lasts 12 calendar months on every tier.
- The Ostomy Medicaid Program has the shortest renewal lead (21 days) and the most frequent coverage re-verification (1 month).
- *Hypothetical illustration:* on a tier with a renewal lead of 30 days, an authorization whose valid-through date falls on day 100 may be renewed from day 70 onward.
